agendas.name: Cold Logic
agendas.description: Each time a SKITARII unit destroys an enemy unit with a ranged attack, it gains 1XP (max 3XP per unit) if either: Protector Imperative is active and the unit is wholly within your deployment zone, or Conqueror Imperative is active and the enemy unit was wholly within the opponent's deployment zone.

agendas.name: Tech Scavengers
agendas.description: Pre-game: select the highest-points enemy VEHICLE as target. If an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit destroys it, that unit gains 3XP. Place a marker where it was destroyed. At battle end, if an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 3" of the marker, acquire one Archeotech Part.

agendas.name: Omnissiah's Will
agendas.description: Once per battle at the start of Command phase: bring glory to the Omnissiah. Until your next turn, each time a CULT MECHANICUS unit destroys an enemy unit, it gains 1XP. Each TECH-PRIEST on the battlefield also gains 1XP. Track tallies per unit.

agendas.name: Break the Seals
agendas.description: Start of Shooting phase: task an eligible ADEPTUS MECHANICUS CHARACTER unit in range of a target objective (no shoot/charge). At end of turn, if still in range, roll D6: on 3+, gain 1XP; on 6, also gain 1 Archeotech Part.

agendas.name: Claim Legendary Archeotech
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent places a Legendary Archeotech marker in their deployment zone. If an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS CHARACTER controls it at battle end, claim one Legendary Archeotech (re-roll duplicates). If opponent controls it, their CHARACTER gains 3XP. Always reduce Location Data by 10.
